phaseA_rule.rule: collapse persists iff u_epi EDT-5px AUROC <= 0.70 AND central-80% range <= 1e-2 (6-vendor mean)

phaseB_rule.rule: a baseline beats the threshold iff paired t (3 seeds) p < 0.05 AND mean delta >= 0.5 Dice
phaseB_rule.note: sign test (exact, one-sided) added S07 for R-17; with n=3 its minimum p is 0.125, so it can only support, never establish, a difference

v18_reproduction_gate_note: E-17: the +/-0.005 tolerance was pre-registered without a same-code replicate; table_replicate.csv (D-10) measures same-code run-to-run spread and must be read alongside any gate verdict

phaseC_rule.rule: BIDMC responds to FDA iff any beta/p setting raises BIDMC Dice by > 0.015 over the default (fixmatch s1337 BIDMC = 0.807287); single seed -> exploratory

E16_signal_identity.claim: converged evidential checkpoints: u_epi = K/(K-1)*(1-p_max) (non-argmax evidence -> 0); holds iff |AUROC gap| <= 0.005 all-pixel, <= 0.01 in EDT-5 band, median ratio within 1% of K/(K-1)

mm_band_curve.note: descriptive: u_epi/conf AUROC inside GT-boundary bands of physical width; the pre-registered collapse rule remains EDT-5px (R-21); quote the whole curve, not one width

R34_screen.rule: after 20 % of max_iterations, any test domain with student Dice <= 0.01 or HD >= 100.0 at the latest evaluation is DEGENERATE (R-34, S07); quarantined names are screened but not listed

R34_screen_v04.rule: REGISTERED rule (HANDOFF section 3 / RULES R-34): after 20 % of max_iterations, a test domain is degenerate if its headline-student Dice (mean over foreground classes) <= 0.01 or its HD equals the empty-prediction sentinel 100.00 on every class, at the latest evaluation. Multi-class extension stated in S11 before any Fundus/M&Ms per-domain value was parsed.
R34_screen_v04.supersedes: R34_screen (v03): parsed net2 for MEDL, parsed nothing on Fundus/M&Ms, used hd >= 100 (E-33)

frozen_student_indicator.definition: headline student and EMA teacher per-domain Dice agree within 0.0005 on every domain/class at the last evaluation (after 20 % of training)
frozen_student_indicator.verdict: NOT DIAGNOSTIC: read the base rate below before reading it on any suspect run (R-43)

nonfinite_screen.rule: a run is UNSTABLE if more than 1% of max_iterations were skipped for a non-finite total loss. POST-HOC threshold (S11, set after seeing the data); flags are identical for any threshold in (0, 0.2)

phaseB_health.note: R-38: flagged runs stay in every table with their per-seed values; nothing is dropped or re-seeded

phaseR_rule.rule: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-03 (before any v18R run existed): d_short = Dice(DAEP) - Dice(threshold) under the short ramp, d_whole = the same difference for the headline s1337 pair; if |d_short - d_whole| <= the B2 replicate tolerance |Dice(rep_a) - Dice(rep_b)|, the schedule is a disclosure with no consequence; otherwise the Discussion paragraph is rewritten to report the dependence. Single seed -> exploratory.
